metadata.title: OpenTUI Backspace clean successor with verifier-owned PTY proof

work.objective: Independently fix the Bun/OpenTUI composer so Backspace deletes typed text and Tab/editing keys reach the native textarea, including option-modifier handling; leave the real Bun PTY proof exclusively to the independent verifier.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths for every read, search, edit and command.
Only modify the three allowlisted input-prompt files; do not modify Ink, renderer dispatch, dependencies, lockfiles, Marshal state, commit, push, publish, use network access or start subagents.

Do not read, search, list, compare, import or copy any R1/R2 worktree, patch, transcript, WorkerResult, ReviewPacket or Marshal run artifact; implement independently from the frozen base branch requirements.
Do not manually slice JavaScript strings to implement deletion; route control/editing keys to TextareaRenderable native bindings.
The printable fallback must reject ctrl, meta, option, super and hyper modifiers, all C0/C1/DEL bytes, escape sequences and named editing/navigation keys while preserving ASCII, CJK and emoji input.

Worker development checks are limited to the unit/OpenTUI vitest commands, CLI typecheck/build and git diff --check; do not launch Bun, expect, PTY diagnostics or background processes because the independent verifier owns native proof.
If an operation is denied, do not retry that path; use an allowed equivalent or report blocked.
context: The user reproduced Backspace not deleting under QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui bun packages/cli/dist/index.js.

Root cause to address: the global useKeyboard printable fallback may treat Backspace DEL (0x7f) and Tab as printable, insert them and preventDefault, so the focused textarea never receives native editing bindings.
Prior runs are blocked and must not be integrated or inspected. This successor starts independently from origin/feat/opentui-migrate.
The independent verifier waits for ready, types ZXQ, observes it, sends DEL then Enter, and requires the user-history line to contain ZX rather than ZXQ.
